Functionality: Fires a workflow upon receiving an Amazon SQS message
Description: The Amazon SQS Trigger fires a workflow whenever a Losant integration receives an Amazon Simple Queue Service (SQS) message.

Functionality: Fires a workflow when Gateway Edge Agent configuration or peripherals change
Description: The Application: Sync Trigger fires a workflow whenever the Gateway Edge Agent receives updated peripherals, global values, or changes to its Edge Compute device configuration.

Functionality: Fires a workflow upon receiving an Azure Event Hubs message
Description: The Azure Event Hubs Trigger fires a workflow whenever a Losant integration receives an Azure Event Hubs message.

Functionality: Fires a workflow when Beckhoff TwinCAT PLC symbols receive new values
Description: The Beckhoff Trigger fires a workflow whenever monitored symbols on a Beckhoff TwinCAT PLC receive new values.

Functionality: Fires a workflow when Data Table rows are modified
Description: The Data Table Trigger fires a workflow whenever a row is added, updated, or removed from a Losant Data Table.

Functionality: Fires a workflow when an Edge or Embedded device receives an MQTT command
Platform Compatibility: Gateway Edge Agent, Embedded Edge Agent
Description: The Device: Command Trigger fires a workflow whenever its Edge Compute or Embedded Device receives a command over the MQTT broker.

Functionality: Fires a workflow when devices connect to the platform
Description: The Device: Connect Trigger fires a workflow whenever one or more devices connect to the Losant Platform.

Functionality: Fires a workflow when a new device is created
Description: The Device: Create Trigger fires a workflow whenever a device is created within your application.

Functionality: Fires a workflow when devices disconnect from the platform
Description: The Device: Disconnect Trigger fires a workflow whenever one or more devices disconnect from the Losant Platform.

Functionality: Fires a workflow when devices fail to report state for a set period
Description: The Device: Inactive Trigger fires a workflow whenever one or more devices do not report state for the configured period of time.

Functionality: Fires a workflow when the Gateway Edge Agent starts
Description: The Device: Startup Trigger fires a workflow whenever the Gateway Edge Agent starts or restarts.

Functionality: Fires a workflow when a device reports state to the cloud
Description: The Device: State Trigger fires a workflow whenever a device reports state to the Losant cloud platform.

Functionality: Fires an Embedded Workflow via method invocation
Description: The Direct Trigger fires an Embedded Workflow whenever the "eea_direct_trigger" method is invoked within the Embedded Edge Agent.

Functionality: Fires a workflow when the EEA init function is called
Description: The EEA: Init Trigger fires a workflow whenever the "eea_init" function is called within the Embedded Edge Agent.

Functionality: Fires a workflow upon receiving an email
Description: The Email Trigger fires a workflow whenever your application receives an email at its address or a subaddress.

Functionality: Fires a workflow when an Experience Endpoint receives an HTTP request
Description: The Endpoint Trigger fires a workflow when the selected Experience Endpoint receives an HTTP request.

Functionality: Fires a workflow when an event is created or updated
Description: The Event Trigger fires a workflow whenever an event matching the criteria defined in the trigger's configuration is created or changes state.

Functionality: Monitors and analyzes logs/files on the agent
Description: The File Tail Trigger allows you to monitor and analyze logs and other files on the Gateway Edge Agent's container or host file system.

Functionality: Fires a workflow on Application File changes
Description: The File Trigger allows you to fire a workflow when a file is created, modified, or deleted from a directory in your Application Files.

Functionality: Fires a workflow when local files or directories change
Description: The File Watch Trigger fires a workflow whenever the file or directory changes are observed on the Gateway Edge Agent.

Functionality: Fires a workflow when a GCP Pub/Sub message is received
Description: The GCP Pub/Sub Trigger fires a workflow whenever a message is sent to a Losant GCP Pub/Sub integration.

Functionality: Fires a workflow on local web server requests
Description: The HTTP Request Trigger fires a workflow whenever the Gateway Edge Agent receives a request on its local web server.

Functionality: Fires a workflow when a Resource Job finishes
Description: The Job: Complete Trigger fires a workflow whenever a Resource Job completes all iterations or is canceled during execution.

Functionality: Fires a workflow at the start of a Resource Job iteration
Description: The Job: Iteration Trigger fires a workflow whenever an iteration of a Resource Job begins.

Functionality: Fires a workflow when a Resource Job iteration times out
Description: The Job: Iteration Timeout Trigger fires a workflow whenever an iteration of a Resource Job is not acknowledged before the Resource Job’s configured timeout.

Functionality: Fires a workflow on MQTT message publication
Description: The MQTT Trigger fires a workflow whenever a message is published to a topic on the Losant MQTT Broker, the Gateway Edge Agent Local Broker, an external broker, or an MQTT integration.

Functionality: Fires a workflow when a Notebook execution completes
Description: The Notebook Trigger fires a workflow whenever the selected Losant Notebook has completed an execution, either successfully or with errors.

Functionality: Fires a workflow on OPC UA node value changes
Description: The OPC UA Trigger fires a workflow whenever an Edge Compute Device receives a change message on the configured OPC UA monitored node.

Functionality: Fires a workflow when a Particle integration event is received
Description: The Particle Trigger fires a workflow whenever an event is received on the Losant Particle integration.

Functionality: Fires a workflow on Redis Pub/Sub channel messages
Description: The Redis Trigger fires a workflow whenever the Edge Compute Device receives a message on the configured Redis Pub/Sub channel.

Functionality: Fires a workflow when data is received over Serial
Description: The Serial Trigger fires a workflow whenever the Edge Compute Device receives data over a Serial connection.

Functionality: Fires a workflow on SNMP traps or inform requests
Description: The SNMP: Trap Trigger fires a workflow whenever the Edge Compute Device receives an SNMP trap message or an SNMP inform request.

Functionality: Fires a workflow on a scheduled interval
Platform Compatibility: Cloud, Gateway Edge Agent, Embedded Edge Agent
Description: The Timer Trigger fires a workflow on a scheduled interval.

Functionality: Fires a workflow on received UDP datagrams
Description: The UDP Message Trigger fires a workflow whenever the Edge Compute Device receives a UDP datagram on the configured port.

Functionality: Fires a workflow when the virtual button is clicked
Description: The Virtual Button Trigger fires a workflow when the "virtual button" is pressed.

Functionality: Fires a workflow on Webhook HTTP or WebSocket requests
Description: The Webhook Trigger fires a workflow whenever a Losant webhook receives an HTTP request or WebSocket message.

Functionality: Fires a workflow on WebSocket integration messages
Description: The WebSocket Trigger fires a workflow whenever a Losant WebSocket integration receives a message.

Functionality: Fires a workflow when an error occurs in another workflow
Description: The Workflow Error Trigger fires a workflow whenever a halting error occurs in a separate workflow execution.
